positions.title: Team Lead, Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Lead an agile team of 6-8 engineers responsible for Bronto’s critical sending and reporting infrastructure.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Member of Bronto’s Sending Team responsible for compiling, processing, sending 400+ million emails per day.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
I am a developer for z Operational Analytics, a cloud-hosted service that provides insights into potential efficiency improvements.  We iterate quickly, taking customer feedback, and deploying updated functionality at least once during every two week sprint.

Job Responsibilities
 • Review designs and implement new functions.
 • Deliver thorough unit and integration tests along with each code delivery.
 • Demo new functionality to sponsored customers.

Technologies used Include the following
• Angular.js
• Java
• JPA
• Protractor, Jenkins, and Karma for testing.
• RTC for source control

positions.title: High Performance Computing Enablement Invention Development Team Member (March 2015- Present)
positions.description: Evaluate Patent disclosures submitted from IBMers for novelty and value to select ideas IP Law should move forward with to pursue patent protection.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Job Responsibilities:
Design, architect, and support compliance and business process applications used by a variety of business units across the organization.
Lead a geographically diverse team in developing multi-circuit board design compliance checking Java application.
Administrate application and database hardware, OS, middleware, and security compliance of machines that run the test and production environments (~2k users).
Create, brainstorm, write patent claims, differentiate from prior art, and assist lawyers in the filing of novel IP to protect business advantage.
Architect and adapt software applications to meet client needs primarily in Java DB2 and PHP.
Orchestrate the software license ordering and software maintenance needs of all employees in 4 first-line managers' departments.

positions.title: Computer Repair Technician
positions.description:
Job Responsibilities:
 • Repair between 30-60 computers per week.  
 • Responsible for both IBM ThinkPads and Apple MacBookPros.
 • Diagnosing/troubleshooting hardware issues, ordering parts, and replacing parts. 

As the most experienced Mac Technician on staff, I advise colleagues who are new to working with Macs. ITS (although we are the largest Lenovo Repair Center by volume in the south east) has just begun to repair Macintosh computers and I have been asked to help establish service procedures.

positions.title: Macintosh Technician
positions.description: Job responsibilities: Repair between 5 and 25 computers per week. This includes diagnosing issues, ordering and installing parts; installing software to meet university standards and custom needs of individual customers; generating quotes for out of warranty or damaged repairs.  Around 1,100 repairs came through the store during my tenure as one of two Macintosh technicians on staff. I also trained and supervised a junior technician toward becoming certified and proficient in repairing Macs.

positions.title: Sales Floor Staff
positions.description:
(30-40 hrs/week May-October 2008); UNC Ram Shop
Responsibilities: Member of a team of around a dozen students and permanent staff who coordinate distribution of pre-ordered Lenovo and Apple computers to approximately 3,000 incoming freshmen, graduate students and faculty; assisted students in deciding which manufacturer (Lenovo or Apple) and model of computer meets their individual needs; processed cash and credit purchases and returns; provided customer service to walk-in customers; opened and closed the store, including balancing the register both at open and close.

volunteerExperiences.description: As a Kramden Volunteer I refurbish donated computers and direct less skilled volunteers through the refurbishing process.  The procedure has four steps: hardware repair, cleaning, software load, final testing.  Kramden is a non profit organization that donates computers and provides free technical support to academically strong but underprivileged students throughout North Carolina. (Kramden.org)

patents.title: Automated computer application update analysis
patents.description:
ABSTRACT
A comparison tool compares metadata that describes an original workflow and metadata that describes a customized workflow. The original workflow and the computer application provide original functionality. The customized workflow is a modified version of the original workflow. The customized workflow and the computer application provide customized functionality. Analysis results, such as a report, are generated that represent the customized functionality. The comparison tool may further compare the original workflow metadata and customized workflow metadata with metadata that describes an updated original workflow. The updated original workflow and an updated version of the computer application provide updated functionality. Analysis results may be generated that represent the customized functionality merged with updated functionality, and a merged workflow may be created. A workflow editor may generate the metadata by associating step-specific metadata, such as origin metadata, type-of-step metadata, and dependency metadata, with individual workflow steps in the workflows.
